decision.reasoning_trace: The search results were heavily cluttered with accessories like travel cases and charging cords rather than actual speakers in the top positions. While high-quality options from Sony and Bose were present, their prices are significantly higher than the mid-range budget I was targeting. Furthermore, many of the more affordable speakers, such as the DOSS Traveler, had recent reviews highlighting reliability and longevity issues (e.g., dying after 2 months). Given the mix of overpriced premium models and questionable quality in the budget range, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
